title: Exact solution of the (2+1)-dimensional damping forcing coupled Burgers equation by using Darboux transformation
summary: In this article, we investigate the (2+1)-dimensional damping forcing coupled Burgers equation, which is obtain by adding damping and forcing terms from couple Burgers equation. The Lax pair of the (2+1)-dimensional damping forcing coupled Burgers equation is established. With the help of Lax pair, we derive the $N$-fold Darboux transformation of (2+1)-dimensional damping forcing coupled Burgers equation.
